🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 3 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Yuki Olsen. From Stonebridge." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
"Stonebridge is eating bark and calling it dinner," Yuki says. "We left before we started looking at each other like food."
They're named, every one: Yuki Olsen, Wren Fischer, Ellis Okafor. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
